Name: Fast Eat
Author: Zexu2K
TagLine: The mod enables quicker eating; there's no need for manual action anymore—just press a single button!
Description:
### Heading 3 Most important thing you need to know:
**Just press V on keybord in the game to eat first edible item in your hotbar**

[align=center]
New way
[/align]

[align=center]
Old way  
[/align] 
![Alt Text](https://i.postimg.cc/05f1Mk4d/new-eat.gif "Old way")

### Heading 2 More info (helpful info):
The mod enables quicker eating; there's no need for quick click to eat something when you're in the mine anymore—just press a single button!
Press the V key on your keyboard, and your character will consume the first item in the hotbar (progressing from left to right).

Eat Second Item Key is similar to Fast Eat key but difference is character eats second meal in order form left to right.

If you wish, You can adjust this button in the config.json file or through the [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098).
![Alt Text](https://i.postimg.cc/7LrQz9LJ/2.png"Config")

Note:
This mod is designed to enhance your gameplay, making things smoother. Should you come across any glitches or issues, kindly notify me through the mod's dedicated website for prompt resolution. 🤠🍔🍕
